title: Accounts for Bipe recovery
summary: Settings → Conta → Contas para voltar ao Bipe (ADR 0096). Links an Apple or a Google account as a recovery factor, shows the linked ones and unlinks them. A linked account never signs in alone and never resets the PIN.

linked.description: true when GET /v1/me/account links has this provider.

available.description: true when GET /v1/links/providers offers a path for it on this platform: Apple native on iOS, else web. An unavailable provider that is not linked is hidden.

phase.description: linking: the provider sign-in or PUT /v1/me/links/{provider} runs. unlinking: DELETE runs.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/links/providers and GET /v1/me/account (links) and sets rows.

link.effect: Asks for the owner check (bipe_linked_account_biometric). Then iOS Apple: POST /v1/me/links/nonce, the Sign in with Apple sheet with that nonce, PUT /v1/me/links/apple with the ID token. Every other case: POST /v1/me/links/{provider}/web, the authorization URL in ASWebAuthenticationSession (iOS) or a Custom Tab (Android), and PUT /v1/me/links/{provider} with flow_id and the handoff of the link-done redirect. A cancelled sheet or tab changes nothing.

unlink.effect: Asks to confirm (bipe_linked_account_unlink_title, bipe_linked_account_unlink_body), then the owner check (bipe_linked_account_unlink_biometric), then DELETE /v1/me/links/{provider}. Shows bipe_linked_account_unlinked.

notes: Both providers on both platforms (ADR 0096). No Google SDK on iOS. Android uses the web flow for both providers in both flavours: Credential Manager needs the Google ID library, which ADR 0150 does not list.
The redirect of the web flow comes back to the app's own URL scheme, `<app id>:/link-done`. The handoff in its fragment works once, only with the flow_id that this phone kept in memory.
A link or an unlink shows on the other devices as a recovery-alert notice (link_events).
Never log or show the ID token, the nonce, the handoff or the provider's account ID.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient link methods and BipeLinkWebFlow (iOS); BipeApiClient link methods and BipeLinkWebFlow (Android).
